description: Mixes an existing song's stems and masters the mix in one go, for example to mix it again after its genre or labels changed; a song made with create_song is already set up for this. It waits for the uploads, the analysis and the person's "Labels are correct" in the studio, then starts by itself. Mixing again starts from Bandmixr's own mix: the person's changes to the stems are not carried over (adjust_mix keeps them). The studio shows the progress and plays the result; a new mix replaces the earlier version made in the chat (downloaded versions and mixes made on the website stay).

master.description: false = mix only, without a master (default true).

songId.description: The song id from list_songs or create_song.

name: mix_and_master
title: Mix and master a song
